name: If data will be processed, stored or transmitted outside the UK or the European Economic Area (EEA), have you considered the relevant security obligations?
requirementTitle: If data will be processed, stored or transmitted outside the UK or the European Economic Area (EEA), have you considered the relevant security obligations?
requirementDescription: If information leaves the UK or EEA, have you checked what legal and security requirements apply?
why:
Cross-border data movement may create additional legal and privacy obligations.
Secure by Design requires teams to understand applicable obligations based on the nature of the service and its data.
